content.prompt: Draw a line of best fit on these scatterplots.

spec.description: Music mark versus Engineering mark; 19 orange observations, 10-mark grid intervals, frame 0–110 and labelled 20-mark ticks.
spec.mathematics: Observation locations are visual reconstructions, not an exact source dataset. House grey grid replaces decorative light blue.
spec.answerVisibility: No fitted line in the question.

answer.short: A downward-sloping straight line through the middle of the observations. Other reasonable lines are acceptable.
answer.worked: The marks show a negative association. Draw a straight line close to the observations, balancing points above and below and keeping within the observed range. One acceptable example passes approximately through $(7,85)$ and $(96,45)$.

spec.description: Experience versus monthly sales in thousands of dollars; 21 orange observations, 1-year and 5-thousand-dollar grid intervals, frame extending to 11 and 55.

answer.worked: Monthly sales generally increase with experience. Draw a straight line close to the observations with roughly equal numbers above and below, confined to their horizontal range. One acceptable example passes approximately through $(0.9,13)$ and $(10,41)$, with sales measured in thousands of dollars.
